title: The direct moving plane method for weak solutions of the fractional $p$-Laplacian
summary: In this paper, we develop the method of moving planes entirely in the weak formulation for the fractional $p$-Laplacian in the singular range $1 p-1$. Our results complete those of Chen-Li (Adv. Math., 2018: 735-758), where analogous results were obtained for $C^{1,1}$ solutions in the pointwise sense.
